title: Vintage Badger Comic Lot Issues 50-59, First Comics 1989
descriptionText:
This product is a vintage comic book lot featuring issues 50-59 of the Badger series from 1989 by First Comics. Written by Mike Baron, these comics fall under the superhero genre within the US Comics tradition. Each comic likely features the character Badger and is a must-have for collectors of comic books and fans of the series.

Vintage Badger comic lot published by First Comics
Created by Mike Baron
Lot includes
Badger issues 50 through 59
Includes the Badger Birthday Bash issue
Later run of the classic 1980s independent comic series
Fun and colorful action stories with distinctive First Comics style
Great lot for collectors filling gaps or fans of Mike Baron titles
You will receive the exact comics shown in the photos
